name: CSCA Math Unlimited Mock Generator

generation.practicalGeneration: Each exam number/seed generates a fresh 48-question instance from parameterized templates.
generation.duplicateNote: This is practically unlimited for the app, but mathematically no finite random template system can guarantee infinite unique questions. A duplicate can be detected and regenerated if needed.

sourceBasis: The current 48-concept bank is aligned to the uploaded CSCA Mathematics syllabus structure represented in the project files: Sets & Inequalities, Functions & Calculus, Geometry & Algebra, Probability & Statistics.
